essence: The practitioner must draw the figure marked with the intended target's name.
Cruel rites are to be performed using substances such as the eight poisons.
The figure must be drawn twelve finger-breadths in size, with clear limbs and great beauty.
The figure should be drawn on an insect-infested corpse-cloth.
After cutting the pieces, one should offer them at night in a pyre-fire while remembering the target.
